title: Measure which lines of the Rust port the comparison cases execute
scope: Use LLVM source-based coverage on the Rust test run that executes original-versus-Rust cases; report lines and branches of each ported function that no comparison case runs.
acceptance: Report is reproducible with one command on the pinned toolchain and lists unexecuted lines per ported unit.
Any unexecuted line in a unit marked implemented is an open item or has a recorded reason.
open_items: Static branch reach is unknown: stable instrument-coverage emits no branch records in this run; do not call this exhaustive branch coverage.
LLVM DA line records disagree with LF/LH summaries on29 owned files; both are retained and raw JSON summaries cross-checked. Interpretation remains unresolved.
35 owned source files are listed, including three module files with no emitted executable records and inline cfg(test) sections. Uninstrumented lines are unknown, not covered.
Independent fuzz/browser profiles, immutable toolchain pinning, exact-base coverage ratchet and accepted status remain open.
